status_vocabulary.implemented: The named source implementation exists; this is not an empirical pass.
status_vocabulary.source_audited: The stated source contract was inspected; this does not establish installed-environment fidelity or benchmark quality.
status_vocabulary.historical_evidence_only: A saved audit or certificate documents a result in its original scope; underlying experiment artifacts were not reopened.
status_vocabulary.current_variant_fidelity_pending: The exact modified variant and its declared controls still require a bound differential or empirical gate before the corresponding claim.

sources.scope: Saved read-only audit; its inspected base and dirty-worktree field describe that historical audit, not the current worktree. No remote verification was repeated.

reused_certificates.scope: Reused CPU correctness evidence for the reviewed base only; no tests were rerun for this matrix and no new metric, checkpoint, quality, latency, or paper-admission pass follows.

Saved certificate reports lossless BF16/MHA source/raw controls on two consumed inputs, exact initial/final/peak physical-byte matching and published-KV-plus-required-storage coverage; separate FP16/GQA FullKV evaluation-boundary controls passed. These do not establish GQA source reconstruction, whole-device GPU peak, independent quality, latency superiority, or six-component benefit.

contract.reduction: Whole selected corpus; never the mean of shard CIDEr or frozen per-image CIDEr scores.
contract.tokenization: PTB tokens may be cached for exact prediction/reference pairs; changed pairs are rejected by TokenizedCider.
contract.document_frequency: Rebuilt for every paired bootstrap draw; repeated identities receive fresh evaluator-local occurrence IDs and count repeatedly.
contract.accelerated_reducer: ResampledCider rebuilds draw-specific DF/IDF, norms and clipped similarities; validate_official compares complete resampled corpora to the official reducer.
contract.input_integrity: Raw completed predictions and all reference captions are required; source-cohort IDs must be unique and paired across points.

metric_readiness.contract: Task-owned parser/scorer; MileBench dispatch distinguishes multiple-choice, token-needle and substring-needle routes. Dataset-level Accuracy and ROUGE-L follow their own hierarchy and are not mixed into a generic macro-score. MathVista percentage points are not interchangeable with fraction-valued Accuracy.
Pinned lmms-eval==0.7.2 ANLS, sample-level fraction and mean reduction; retain multiple references and the registered threshold. Do not substitute exact-match Accuracy or CIDEr.

Pinned rouge==1.0.1 ROUGE-L F1; PrefixKV uses a hash-bound deterministic FullKV output reference artifact, while MileBench applies its dataset-specific normalization/routing. Report these scopes separately and never call a measured ROUGE value a published-numeric reproduction pass without a registered target.

Corpus PPL is exp(sum token NLL / sum evaluated tokens), not a mean of per-sample PPL. Exact teacher-forcing targets and FullKV output references have separate hashes; generated-reference ROUGE-L is a different metric. Generic metric export refuses to invent PPL from task_score.

Pair identical sample IDs and preserve metric-specific corpus or hierarchy reduction for each draw. Ordinary percentile intervals are diagnostic unless the preregistered family and multiplicity procedure separately justify a confirmatory claim. Metric confidence intervals are not adjusted latency-ratio certificates.

baseline_readiness.historical_evidence: The pinned source audit documents an official published-PPL operating-point pass and a separate bounded official/local diagnostic pass; it also preserves a later negative parity gate. This matrix does not reopen those artifacts, repeat their values, or certify current modified-variant parity.
label_rules: Official upstream execution, faithful local prefixkv_reimpl, and current byte-adapted comparisons are separate categories.
Question-scored selection-only, byte-rescaled, bounded-history, generalized-model and source-storage adaptations must disclose their exact labels and deviations.
Preserve compatible historical predictions and negative outcomes; no blanket rerun of the historical nominal-ratio campaign.

baseline_readiness.identity: Local paper-derived reimplementation of ICLR VL-Cache, not official author software and not the similarly named recurring-image reuse system.
baseline_readiness.historical_evidence: The source audit documents local retrospective measurements, not a current-variant fresh confirmation or published-operating-point reproduction.
disclosures_required: common HF execution rather than specialized paper kernels

baseline_readiness.historical_evidence: The pinned source audit documents a patched official-path CPU import/random-model diagnostic, not GPU reproduction of a published operating point. Later compatibility or checkpoint diagnostics, if cited elsewhere, retain their own scope and do not become current baseline-quality evidence through this matrix.
label_rules: Local execution is lookm_reimpl; compatibility patches remain separately pinned and labeled.
Do not infer the cause of degradation without a matched differential test.
Representative MileBench subsets are not the complete benchmark; report Accuracy and ROUGE-L separately.

remaining_empirical_gates.requirement: Bind current scorer/parser versions to prompt03's fixed validation subset and explicit empty/whitespace/option-label/answer-prefix/EOS-padding/multiple-reference fixtures. Retain raw and parsed outputs, invalid-output counts and inclusion rules; existing source tests are not a newly executed complete scoring gate.

Either prove the exact current implementation/decode controls unchanged from the bounded passing path, or, when separately authorized, run only a bounded differential gate on prompt03's first fixed validation inputs or representative saved attention fixtures. Compare scoring, quotas, mandatory/recent windows, retained IDs, cache lengths and relevant tensors; preserve the recorded negative path.

Bind exact current local baseline source/configuration and fixtures to the paper-derived spec or available pinned upstream path; for LOOK-M include merged tensors. Unavailable upstream execution remains fidelity_unverified, never official_reproduced. This is distinct from byte-adapted quality comparisons.

For the intended comparison, require identical prompts/media/processor/tokenization/generation/output length/precision/HF backend/attention and cache accounting. Require retention-1 FullKV equivalence, clone/state isolation, actual constructed caches and equal measured initial/final/peak live backing bytes including padding/preallocation and required storage. Reuse passed controls only within their exact certified variant/input boundary; no universal whole-device memory claim.

Apply prompt03's separately labeled A/B protocol only on adapter-valid inputs, with independent FullKV chunked-prefill controls, original logical positions, no duplicate held-back token, common available-prefix observations and matched representable allocation. Preserve blocked inputs and separate unequal-capacity strata. Corrected FP16/GQA FullKV transport certificates do not establish all compressed variants' first-answer sensitivity.

Before new quality claims, bind the frozen exact variant, immutable cohort/media/reference ledgers, evaluator/runtime identities and complete paired predictions; recompute the correct cohort-level reducer and preserve failures. Any correction affecting scores must cover all affected methods on the same inputs while retaining invalidated pre-fix history. Fresh confirmation remains separately blocked.

Preregister the metric-specific paired analysis, confidence level, tested family and multiplicity handling. A strict compressed-method latency claim requires the adjusted upper ratio bound <=1.00 against measured eligible competitors; <=1.05 is a tradeoff, not acceptance. FullKV is a quality reference, excluded from compressed-method latency ranking. No metric-source or CPU-suite pass establishes quality, latency, or six-component benefits.

execution_scope.scope_note: vLLM/SGLang or specialized-kernel reproduction is not a prerequisite for a narrowly labeled HF comparison. Claims about those engines or published acceleration would need separate evidence.
